The absolute best. Obviously not for all, which is why 4 stars, but THIS DOES NOT STING/BURN!!!! As a cosmetologist, my goal was to find something for the hormonal babes. After months and deep searching the internet for 24+ hrs at times... This is fungal, alcohol, sulfrate, fragrance, etc FREEEEEEEEEEEEEEEEE!!!!! FREE FREE FREE! This product has passed all clean ingredients despite the old past the OG founder had with the brand. DO NOT CHANGE ANYTHING ABOUT THIS PRODUCT. Or i will sue, lol.

avis.titre: Gentle, effective, and leaves my skin glowing
avis.texte: I love this face wash! It cleans my skin really well without drying it out or making it feel tight. My face feels fresh, smooth, and balanced after every use. I've noticed my skin looks clearer and more even since I started using it. The gel texture is lightweight and feels great on the skin. Definitely a staple in my routine!
My favorite cleanser! Nothing was able to shrink my pores for years- until I found this cleanser! If large pores are an issue for you- this should be your go to!

avis.titre: Leaves my skin soft and smooth
avis.texte: I really like this. It's a nice gentle cleanser. It leaves my skin soft and smooth. I will be repurchasing the bigger size
I always add this item to my order when I have points to use. It is the perfect size for travel or small spaces. It cleanses beautifully and doesn't over-dry my already dry, mature skin.

I never write reviews for cleansers because they're too stripping or just meh. Cleansers arent really an exciting product to use, but this right here…its so good. Cleansing my skin without drying it out and after using this for a few months, my pores or almost invisible. Every time I try to switch it up, I regret it.

I bought this as an alternative to another brand that is not cruelty free, snd i love this one even more! It is gentle and works in perfect combination with my oil cleanser. I never feel like I ever have makeup or residue left, and also dont feel dried out. I will keep repurchasing and dont even feel the need to try others out anymore!

I have combination acne prone skin and have discovered less is more (aka my cleanser doesn't have to be an exfoliating gritty acid). since I started using this with a gently exfoliating sponge my skin has really improved.

Gently, brightening, sensitive skin friendly! I have been using for over a year and love it! I am almost 30 with acne prone skin/lots of PIE. This face wash pair with a silicone facial massager gently cleans without stripping. I have NEVER noticed a smell as other reviews have mentioned. I strictly use fragrance free products for my sensitive skin.

I was looking for a basic cleanser to use on days I don't use my AHA/BHA cleanser. This has a nice gel texture and foams up nicely. It leaves my skin clean but not tight feeling. It doesn't dry it out. You get over 7 ounces of product for a great price.
This is the third time I have purchased. Gentle on my skin and a great cleanser.

I have oily skin, and have never really felt like I had a face wash that truly made a difference. Well, until I randomly tried this! Love the way it feels on my skin, and it looks clearer and brighter!

I first bought this in the travel size because it was only five dollars, but I fell in love and kept buying travel sizes until I finally purchased the full size! This cleanser has helped me clear my skin so well and the sebaceous filaments on my nose have been reduced thanks to this product. I absolutely reccomemd! This doesn't dry my skin out, and I have oily combo skin. If you have doubts, but the travel size! As I mentioned, it's only five dollars. The travel size lasts me 1-2 months.
I don't feel the product cleans my face that well but my biggest issue is the smell. It smells like a dirty rag that was left out, I dont even want to finish the bottle.

I have oily skin, and I feel like the face washes I've tried never really did anything for me. I randomly picked this up to try and I'm in loooooove. My skin feels so clean and is already looking glowy!
I had been using the Youth to the People Superfood cleanser, but this is a much cheaper alternative. I have very sensitive skin and it is not irritating, and is really great bang for your buck.
This is my go to face wash its gentle on my skin and doesnt leave it feeling dry
If you're looking for an affordable cleanser that actually works, this is it. I have extremly dry skin and every time I use this, it never dries my face out. Love it!

Love everything about this face wash. It has a natural smell and glides on effortlessly. I might replace my Cetaphil for this :)

avis.titre: Price performer, gentle and effective on skin
avis.texte: This was extremely helpful with an unexpected breakout. It was BAD. I was told that I was being too harsh with my skin for it to heal, and they suggested niacinamide. It still took a while for the really stubborn zits to go away, but it did a lot of good for my pores and was much more gentle on my skin than what I was using, which was exactly what I needed. It's a price performer, too.
Nice cleanser but packaging needs adjustment. Product comes out too quickly and is wasted because you don't need very much to be effective. Gentle, not irritating to eyes or Sun.

This review is NOT incentivized. I just lovd it. This cleanser is perfect for my dry combo skin. Gentle enough to not strip my dry parts, and removes excess oil from my T-zone. The niacinamide is so good for my large pores too. Highly reccommend.

I bought this because I was in a hurry and needed facial cleanser. I feel I made a good choice. The cleanser leaves my face feeling clean and not tight. It creates a good lather with a bit of water added and rinses off easily.
This is my favorite cleanser of all time. I have sensitive combination skin and using this makes my skin feel clean, but not stripped, and soft and smooth. 10/10 will be repurchasing forever.

My friend bought this and let me try it, so when I needed a cleanser I bought the travel size (only five bucks!) and OH MY GOODNESS I love this so much! It's non stripping, but cleans well and doubles as a mask. It's brightening too! I'm on my third travel size bottle (travel size because my budget is tinyyyy) but the travel size lasts me about three months! A little goes a very long way. I have combo/oily skin and my friend has dry. It worked so well for both of us! Go get it!

avis.titre: Missed it so much I had to come back!
avis.texte: I had used this product for a long time but I stopped using it so I could just finish up every other face wash I had. In the two weeks it took me to finish my other products, I developed the most noticeable blackheads on my nose! I had never had that problem before and it was super embarrassing. Within 3 days of going back to this facewash my face cleared up! Its crazy to see how much of a difference it made. 100% recommend this product.
So soothing and gentle!!!! Yet takes off all my makeup i love it!!! Going to keep using this i love it:)
i have normal skin and use this as my final.cleanser after make up remover. Noticed that the skin around my eye area still has mascara and is bone dry. as a result my skin is dirty and itchy.

avis.titre: Best Cleanser I have ever used
avis.texte: I picked this cleanser up on a complete whim after seeing it in the store and I am so glad I did. It is like a double cleanse in one step. Heavy mineral sunscreen melts away. My skin in clog and break out prone and I have to be careful because I will break out if I use an oil cleanser and don't cleanse thoroughly enough with the second step. It is really nice to avoid this but still get all my sunscreen off in one step. I adore the consistency. It has a plush gel texture that turns to soft creamy bubbles and rinses completely clean but without leaving that tight feeling. It nudged out my previous HG cleanser that I thought I would never stop using: Krave Matcha Hemp.

I have found this cleanser to be too drying for me personally, though I see many others disagree so YMMV. I have pretty dry skin at baseline especially in the winter, and Ive had some dry patches and stinging since switching to this cleanser. I have needed a massive increase in the amount of moisturizer I'm using to keep up. I was hoping to find a gel cleanser I liked just because I prefer the texture but seems cream cleanser will still be the way to go. Also as some others have mentioned the packaging is horrible, the first one I got was broken and Ulta replaced it, the second is intact but now gets jammed and clogged all the time.

Love this cleanser, even got my fiancé obsessed with it too. We've been through multiple bottles and will continue to buy more. The gel texture feels very silky and soothing, and overall my skin looks healthier since I started using it. I have very sensitive oily skin and I have not experienced any irritation or breakouts from this cleanser, nor does my face feel dry or tight if I don't put moisturizer on immediately after. It's a great product. I also love the pump dispenser. I only removed 1 star because it doesn't always completely remove eye makeup, and I haven't noticed much difference in oil production. Those things are not a big deal to me, but were worth noting for the review.

I got a sample size and immediately had to purchase the large bottle. I use this as my first step in my two step cleansing process. It is great at removing makeup without stripping the skin. Leaves the skin clean and smooth with no abrasive properties. I have seen a huge improvement of my skin since the first use. I have very very sensitive skin so im always apprehensive to try new things and this is an instant win!
When I bought this I LOVED it. As I continued to use it I felt like my skin was irritated. I switched to vanicream and my skin is better than ever. I think it may work for some but not me.
I really liked this jelly cleanser. I felt smooth and my skin felt clean after.

This product has worked amazing on my skin. This top all cleansers I've ever used. I know some products doesn't work for all skin types but if you're looking for something that will help improve your skin, Buy this.

The first week i used it i had terrible irritation and swelling. I stop because my dr and i thought it was seasonal allergies, I stopped using it for about a month and a half. 3 days ago 12.1.24 today 12.3.24 is how long ive used it for again to see if it was the product and i can tell you it definitely is because i wake up with the same reactions. I've officially stopped using 🚮. I love the brabd, but not this particular product.

This cleanser does a great job at balancing my skin, whether it is hot or cold weather. I can trust this cleanser to keep my skin's oil under control during the warmer months and also trust it to not over-dry in the winter months.
Love this cleanser!!!! Its not stripping but does a great job at removing my makeup and build up beautifully, im acne prone but ive noticed my scars lightening up

I had never heard of this brand before and got really excited to see it come to Ulta. I've used it for 2 weeks and so far my face hasn't broke out which is great! My dark spots have faded a bit (:

I love this cleanser. Feels super refreshing and does not make my skin feel dry.

I have been on a mission to find a good deep cleaning daily cleanser and I think this is the one! I often switch from washing my face in the sink or the shower so I love that this one doesn't need water to start emulsifying. I have been using this for about a week now and I can feel the dirt lifting out of my pores when I use this. Afterwards I am left with a glowing skin, and my combo skin has been a lot less oily.
I have tried many cleansers but this is my holy grail, I have been using it for about twi years. It does not break me out and does not leave my skin dry or sensitive. The best ever!

I was running out of my korean water cleanser and needed a new one quick. I decided to give this one a try since i was already in store and dont regret it one bit. I always double cleanse with an oil cleanser and then a water cleanser. Although this is a gel cleanser, it did not dry out my skin. Im very oily and this did an amazing job and making my skin feel and look refreshed. You do not need a lot of product. This will replace my old water cleanser.

I love this face mask! A little goes a long way, i only have to use one pump. I slightly wet my face and apply/lather then i let it sit for a couple mintutes then wash off. In the instructions it says you can use it like a face mask. This is perfect for my combo skin. It doesnt overy strip my skin and leaves me feeling very even in texture and tone. Everytime i try something new and it breaks me out I go back to this cleanser. I will always countine to use this product.

Amazing! Like a bouncy cloud when it lathers up and never feels stripping or drying. I'm obsessed and already bought another one, plus one for my boyfriend and one for my friend.

The best second cleanse I've ever used! My skin never feels dry and a little goes a very long way.

It's only been 3 weeks of using this but I am loving it. My face feels clean without stripping it and my skin has been clearer and smoother. Excited to see more results as I use it longer.

It was then that I realized how drying this was, at least in the winter (despite using daily essence, hydrating serum and moisturizer). Even though it says it can be used twice a day, I think that many skin types will find that too drying. I will stick to using it a few times a week, but now the search is on for a cleanser I can use twice daily.

I was recommended by a friend and don't want to switch to anything else. My skin is really sensitive and dry. I bought this starter kit to try out this brand out and fell in love with it. I will be sticking with it. The other thing is that it does not break the bank like other skincare products do. Highly recommend!
Love this cleanser. No bells & whistles, such as fragrance, but I have sensitive skin, so has what I need.
